differences.what: A crops the blue bezel almost against the left frame edge and lets the driver fill the frame with no breathing room; B sits the driver inside the visible enclosure frame with margin on all sides, so the composition reads as a deliberate detail shot
B shows the clear enclosure's edges, thickness and rounded internal blocks, so the material reads as acrylic; in A the left and lower structure is a murky blue-grey mass with little edge definition
A's right side is a broad flat pale slab with a saturated cobalt strip that looks like an untextured placeholder; B's right edge shows layered glass thickness, a bevel and a small caustic highlight
B's overall key is lighter and airier with a soft gradient across the set; A is darker and heavier in the upper-left and behind the bezel, more muddy than moody

Both bezels are a flat uniform blue with no specular roll-off, and both cones are matte grey with only faint banding at the surround; this CG flatness caps both scores, slightly worse in B where the ring is larger relative to frame light
